$comment: ADR-023 action-authorization matrix seed. Each entry maps a dot-separated action name to an array of group IDs allowed to invoke it. The special 'admin' group means Nextcloud admins; admins always pass regardless. Empty array or ['admin'] means admin-only. Administrators change the stored matrix in the section 'Rechten per actie' on the tenant management page; these values are the defaults it resets to. Add an entry to 'actions' and a label and description to 'labels' for every ActionAuthService::requireAction() call site.
